title: Going Places with Ernie Dingo
description: Ernie visits Queensland's Stradbroke Island and meets up with traditional landowners, spends time with a talented artist and gets up close and personal with manta rays.

title: Citizen Minutes
description: A profile of veteran activist and first-term Vancouver city councillor Jean Swanson as she works alongside the next generation of anti-poverty activists fighting systemic inequality.

title: Citizen Minutes
description: Amid migration grief and integration challenges, Juan Manuel, a doctor turned community leader, guides immigrant men through a life-changing program, forging resilience, belonging, solidarity and hope.

title: Hope for Wildlife
description: Preparations for Hope's open house are derailed when a patient goes missing; the event may be too successful for its own good.

title: Art Lives
description: Delving into Soheila Esfahani's journey from Iran to Canada, exploring her profound inspiration and recent installation, "Cultured Pallets: Aga Khan Museum".

title: All-Round Champion
description: The next sport is inline racing; Chandra and Olympian Jordan Belchos help the athletes stay on their feet and skate as fast as they can; the athletes compete in the longest race in ARC history.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: The friends are playing music together, but when it's Doodoowah's turn, he just stays silent and doesn't play at all; Doodoowah gets up and walks off, leading them all to a place where they have no choice but to be quiet.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: Jasmine wants to play a song for Dudua's birthday party and Jambo wants to dress up for the occasion, but the music she plays and the clothes he wears don't go together; Jambo and Jasmine try different music and outfits to see if they match.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: The wind ruins Donkey and Panda's Camp Buddy plan.

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: Building a clubhouse causes friction between Emily Elizabeth, Samantha and Pablo.

title: Colourblocks
description: Red is on a color tour with her friends, showing them the sights of where she did her very first coloring in Colorland.

title: Bamboo Loves Music
description: Bamboo Love learns about the sounds that come from the misunderstood instrument called the Accordion.

title: Wolf Joe
description: Hoping to win the local art contest, each of the trio search for something interesting in nature to paint.

title: Odo
description: In the Forest Camp for Young Birds, Odo, a little owl with big ideas, tackles every challenge with the help of his best friend Doodle.

title: Pip and Posy
description: Pip and Posy do a dance show when Pip gets paint on his bottom.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: After Pudding gets a hoverboard for his birthday, he loves it so much that he stays on it for days and days and stops playing with his brother and sister.

description: Big Trev tells Pounce and Gemma a tale from his childhood as they wait for his elderly turtle friend, Salty, to arrive.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes seek shelter in a cave during a wild snowstorm, but it looks like other Vegesaurs had the same idea.

title: Riley Rocket
description: Riley starts the day off trying to beat her time for putting her shoes on and falls short. That's ok, she'll keep trying. Meanwhile, Kaboom uses his new sleeperizer invention to put the people of Greenville to sleep. That way he can work on his inventions in peace and quiet! Megablast is spared because they have headphones on while making a recording, but Aunt Jenny falls asleep along with the rest of the town. Megablast transforms into Rocket, Thunder and Metallics to save the town.

title: Isadora Moon
description: Oscar wants to take part when Isadora prepares a special witch event for Mirabelle.

title: PAW Patrol
description: After stowing away on the Turbots' camping trip, Wally the walrus gets stuck in a mountain crevasse, and it's up to Everest and the PAW Patrol to rescue him; Mayor Humdinger challenges Rubble for the right to deejay a dance party.

title: Interstellar Ella
description: Tilly convinces Ella to teach her how to ride her scooter. But the task is harder than Ella thought, so she cheats and uses a remote control to help Tilly. When Tilly finds out, she gets herself in trouble. Both student and teacher learn that sometimes slow wins the race! Then, when Tilly breaks her stuffy Unistorm, Slippy promises to fix it. Over-enthusiastic, he turns it into the kind of stuffy he would like, instead of what Tilly would like.

title: Burps, Butts and Bones
description: Jack dives into the gooey world of snot, boogers, and mucus to uncover their slimy secrets. Meeting up with Cole from Scales Nature Park, he gets an appreciation of how mucus benefits a lot of creatures. Then Marie from Mad Science helps him to decode what the different colours of his snot means.

title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
description: B.O.T. tries to keep up with a family of Huggy Rollers as they roll along together; B.O.T. ends up encased in a snowball, but the snow melts away when the Rollers give it a big warm hug!

title: Odd Squad
description: Omni and Onom must track down a mysterious creature with a peculiar habit; Orli has to help new recruit Osric complete his training.

title: Work It Out Wombats!
description: The search for Mr. Splendito tickets is on; the Wombats power-clean a bunch of bikes.

title: ScienceXplosion
description: Eric learns all about the dinosaurs that lived on over 65 million years ago and their fossils that can be found deep in the ground.

title: The Screen Team
description: Curious about what happens to old devices, Reid and Leia head to Greentec, a high-tech recycling facility. They learn how devices are wiped, taken apart, and transformed into materials for brand-new technology.

title: Colourblocks
description: Set in the world of Colorland, characters Red, Yellow, Blue, Purple, Orange and Green embark on colorful adventures; they discover the world overflows with color.

title: The Singalings
description: Inquisitive and eager extraterrestrials discover all they can about Earth.

title: Mia & Codie
description: It's the neighborhood Block Party and Codie wants to help; no one seems to need his help except Otis. When Otis' cotton candy machine breaks down, Codie spins the sugar, making cotton candy using code.

title: Bamboo Loves Music
description: Bamboo Love learns about the Trumpet and finds it is a blast to play alone or with a friend.

title: Numberblocks
description: It's a lovely day for a picnic, but one of the flapjacks is missing and there could be a flapjack-snaffler on the loose.

description: Kenny G sings about the letter V to a crowd of animals, voicing his love for vacations by the sea, vegetables and volleyball.

title: Create

title: ABC SingSong
description: It's doing good things for bodies and minds; a song about the word healthy.

title: Raven's Quest
description: Lovely lives in Toronto, and has Ojibwe, African and Filipino ancestry; her fancy shawl regalia has a South African flag on it; Lovely solves a puzzle in record time; visits the park with her sister Blessing.

title: Wordsville

When Slippy realizes that Ella is headed towards a star about to explode, he rushes to warn her.

description: The Game Catchers land on the Halloween Planet and discover that they're being followed; the Game Catchers land on a cartoon planet and must locate missing cans to play a new game.

description: When Bumpi hears something going TWEET, TWEET in the yard, he, LiLi, and Edgar follow their ears to try and find out who or what was making the sound.

title: Odd Squad
description: Agent Olympia is miffed when another agent with the same name shows up at headquarters.

title: Wild Kratts
description: The Wild Kratts set out to save the pangolins from Chef Gourmand Gaston, who is using the pangolin scales to make smoothies.

title: MojoSwoptops

description: Koralee and Andee get crafty building a bumper of a marble run... on a door?!

With help from the Green Squad, she creates DIY games using recycled materials, like a seashell diving contest and a boat race with homemade crafts. Instead of buying plastic-wrapped snacks, the team visits a local farmer's market to make fresh, plastic-free popsicles using fruit, honey, and edible flowers. Along the way, they learn how everyday choices can help the planet.

A crew of coders program the commands to make the game run properly. Brody joins a lucky team of testers who get to play and troubleshoot video games!
